risks.risk: The tires may be worn or have low tread depth.
risks.proof: A photo of the tread on both tires.

risks.risk: The brakes may be seized or have worn pads.
risks.proof: A video showing the brakes being operated.

proof_requests: Photo of the front and rear of the bike showing the frame.
Photo of the drivetrain (chain, cassette, and derailleurs).
Photo of the tires showing the tread.
Photo of the brake levers and pads.
Video of the bike being pedaled and the brakes being applied.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
